text.p: Headway Corporate Resources Inc said Tuesday it had entered into a letter of intent to acquire a major temporary staffing company in North Carolina.
A company spokesman said details concerning the acquisition will be elaborated on as the deal nears its expected closing date by the end of the first quarter of 1997.
Completion of the acquisition is subject to negotiation and execution of a definitive purchase agreement.

The staffing company had approximately $32 million in temporary staffing and payroll revenues for 1996 (corrects to clarify that company to be bought, not Headway, had $32 million revenues). Headway provides human resources and advisory services to the financial services industry.
